# Agent instructions: Business Network Process Genome

Static site on Render (publish directory `site/`) at https://process-genome.onrender.com/. The prototype changes quickly
and several sessions push to `main`, so follow these steps on every change. README.md has the full background.

## Generated files: never hand-edit

| File | Generated by |
|---|---|
| `site/index.html` | `node tools/build-site.mjs /path/to/master.html` (master = the claude.ai artifact build) |
| `site/llms.txt`, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/agents/*.txt` | `tools/agent-docs.mjs`, called by `build-site.mjs` |
| `site/command-center/index.html`, the Command Center block in `site/index.html` | `python3 tools/command-center/apply.py site/index.html` |
| `site/robots.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml`, `tools/crawl-state.json` | `node tools/crawl-files.mjs`, called by both builds above |

Change the source (master, `tools/agent-docs.mjs`, `tools/command-center/*`), then rebuild.

## Build order

```sh
node tools/build-site.mjs /path/to/master.html
python3 tools/command-center/apply.py site/index.html
node tools/crawl-files.mjs        # only needed after a change under site/ made outside the two builds
```

## Crawling: keep robots.txt and sitemap.xml current

Google, Bing and AI assistants find the site through `site/robots.txt` and `site/sitemap.xml`. Copilot and other
assistants that answer through Bing search can only read pages Bing has indexed, so the sitemap must list every page
and agent file.

- Both builds run `tools/crawl-files.mjs`. It lists every `index.html` (except `stats/`), `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`
  and `agents/*.txt`, and moves a URL's `lastmod` only when that file's content changes.
- A new page or agent file of those kinds is picked up automatically. A new kind of crawlable file (another folder,
  another extension) needs a rule in `crawlable()` in `tools/crawl-files.mjs`.
- Keep the site crawlable: `Allow: /` for every agent; only `/stats/` is disallowed. Do not add `noindex` tags or
  `X-Robots-Tag` headers.
- Agent files stay markdown in `.txt` files so they are served as `text/plain`; some agent fetchers refuse `text/markdown`.
- If the site moves to another host, update `ORIGIN` in `tools/crawl-files.mjs` and rebuild.

## Before every push

```sh
node tools/crawl-files.mjs --check         # fails if robots.txt or sitemap.xml are out of date
node --test tools/command-center/retail.test.cjs
npm test                                   # stats service tests and the crawl check
git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main
```

Render does not deploy on push: after pushing a change under `site/`, trigger a deploy of the `process-genome` static
site (service `srv-dbdlutbncjis73aldb70`) and confirm the change is live.

Commit `site/robots.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml` and `tools/crawl-state.json` with the pages they describe. On a rebase
conflict in any of them, take either side, then run `node tools/crawl-files.mjs` and commit the result.

## Content rules

- Concept preview for internal review: never present capabilities as generally available.
- Every customer, partner and figure in examples and prototypes is illustrative.
- No em dashes in any site copy or agent file.
